corrected_draft.title: SEC Filing Reports Ramaswamy Held 8.4% of Strive
corrected_draft.description_short: An SEC amendment reported Vivek Ramaswamy beneficially owned 5,693,897 Strive shares, or 8.4%, in a filing tied to an April 20, 2026 event.
corrected_draft.description_medium: An SEC Schedule 13D amendment reported that Vivek Ramaswamy beneficially owned 5,693,897 shares of Strive, Inc., equal to 8.4% of the class on the filing’s stated conversion assumption. The filing identifies April 20, 2026 as the event date. It says the issuer’s at-the-market share sales ended the shareholder agreement and dissolved the reporting group; Ramaswamy continued to own more than 5%. The amendment does not support the held record’s 7.6% figure or May 28 date.
corrected_draft.description_long: An SEC Schedule 13D amendment filed by Vivek Ramaswamy and other reporting persons states that he beneficially owned 5,693,897 Strive, Inc. shares, representing 8.4% of the class under the filing’s stated assumption that Class B shares convert to Class A. The filing identifies April 20, 2026 as the event date. It explains that Strive’s at-the-market share sales increased the number of outstanding shares, causing the reporting group to fall below the 50% voting-power threshold in its shareholder agreement. The agreement then terminated automatically, and the reporting persons ceased to constitute a group. The amendment says Ramaswamy still beneficially owned more than 5% and would report separately; the other exiting persons fell below 5%. This establishes an ownership disclosure and reporting change. It does not support the held entry’s claim of a 7.6% stake as of May 28, nor any assertion that his Ohio policy platform was designed to benefit Strive investors.
